visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Pattern that accepts everything
visualizerParams.problemDescription: This username field should accept only lower-case letters, three to eight of them. It accepts "AB" and even an empty value, because of a mistake in its attributes.

solution.explanation: A pattern is ignored when it is not a valid regular expression (the closing brace was missing), and an empty value is only rejected when the input has required. Fix both and the browser blocks wrong values by itself.

checks.label: An empty username is not valid
